name: War Wizard's Robes

effects.name: Resistance
effects.tooltip: Resistance +6 : Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

effects.name: Archmagi
effects.tooltip: Archmagi : This item grants the wearer +200 maximum spell points . Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.

effects.name: Elemental Absorption
effects.tooltip: Elemental Absorption +5% : Passive: 5% Enhancement Bonus to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Electrical Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)

effects.name: Concentration
effects.tooltip: Concentration +15 : Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.

effects.name: Battle Arcanist
effects.tooltip: Battle Arcanist : When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.

flavor_text: Layered with protective enhancements, these are the robes that the War Wizards of Cormyr wear into battle.
notes: Unlike most enchanted clothing, this does not provide any Armor Bonus. It is intended to be worn alongside the War Wizard's Bracers which offers Armor Bonus +9 .

source.raw: Eveningstar , Turn in 10 Commendations: War Wizards
